ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR48] Requires Cloud Provider while in Negotiation only, for Digitization/Info Governance/InSight deals. Formula updated 2026-09-24 to drop Solutioning (was not yet removed).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Digitization'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Information Governance'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'InSight') ),
ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'),
ISPICKVAL(Cloud_Provider__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cloud Provider is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
